name: veenna-community
description: Veenna Community: free, on-device dictation. No account, no cloud.
author: veenna

scripts.electron:dev: bun scripts/ensure-native-arch.cjs && bun run electron:icons && bun --bun concurrently -k "bun --bun cross-env VITE_IS_ELECTRON=true VITE_EDITION=community bun --bun vite --port 3021" "bun --bun wait-on http://localhost:3021 && bun --bun cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:3021 VITE_IS_ELECTRON=true VITE_EDITION=community VEENNA_EDITION=community ELECTRON_DEV=true electron ."
scripts.electron:build: bun run electron:build:monitor && bun run electron:icons && bun scripts/bundle-whisper-model.cjs && bun scripts/prepare-whisper.cjs --platform darwin --arch arm64,x64 && bun --bun cross-env VITE_EDITION=community ELECTRON_BUILD=true bun --bun vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac --publish never
scripts.electron:build:unsigned: bun run electron:build:monitor && bun run electron:icons && bun scripts/bundle-whisper-model.cjs && bun scripts/prepare-whisper.cjs --platform darwin --arch arm64,x64 && bun --bun cross-env VITE_EDITION=community ELECTRON_BUILD=true CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false bun --bun vite build && bun --bun cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac --publish never
scripts.electron:build:win: bun run electron:icons && bun scripts/bundle-whisper-model.cjs && bun scripts/prepare-whisper.cjs --platform win32 --arch x64 && bun --bun cross-env VITE_EDITION=community ELECTRON_BUILD=true CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false bun --bun vite build && bun --bun cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win --x64 --publish never -c.npmRebuild=false
